source: Hand-curated based on ACLED + open-source reporting (April 2026)

events.title: Limpet mine strike — UAE-flagged tanker
events.summary: MT Pacific Falcon (UAE) reports hull breach east of Larak Island; IRGC denies involvement; insurance market spikes 240 bps overnight.

events.title: IRGC FAC sortie from Bandar Abbas
events.summary: Sentinel-2 imagery shows 8 Boghammar-class FACs deployed from Bandar Abbas naval base; deployment matches pre-2019 Front Altair posture.

events.title: GCC emergency session — Riyadh
events.summary: GCC foreign ministers convene; UAE pushes for Combined Task Force 152 expanded ROE; Oman dissents and pushes mediation track.

events.title: Lloyd's JWC reclassifies strait as 'high-risk listed area'
events.summary: Joint War Committee adds full Hormuz transit corridor to Listed Areas; war-risk premium standard rate moves from 0.04% to 0.5% hull value.

events.title: Aramco activates contingency at Ras Tanura
events.summary: Aramco redirects 2.1 MBD via Petroline to Yanbu; Asian buyers (China, India, Japan) renegotiate term contracts.

events.title: USS Reagan CSG departs Diego Garcia
events.summary: CVN-76 strike group transits to position 200 nm SE of Strait of Hormuz; F/A-18 CAP established over Gulf of Oman.

events.title: IRGC midget sub detected near Abu Musa
events.summary: Open-source ESM intercepts indicate Ghadir-class sub on the surface near Abu Musa; brief radio comms suggest reposition order.

events.title: Iraq oil exports halted at Khor al-Amaya
events.summary: Iraq's SOMO suspends loading at Khor al-Amaya pending Lloyd's reassessment; 1.6 MBD south crude flow paused 96 hours.

events.title: China issues neutral statement
events.summary: Beijing's MOFA calls for 'all parties to exercise restraint'; declines to attribute responsibility for Apr 18 incident; Chinese tankers continue transit at premium rates.

events.title: Greek-flagged VLCC reports IRGC hailing
events.summary: MT Athenian Voyager (Greek-flagged, China-bound) reports IRGC patrol bridge-to-bridge hail demanding inspection 18 nm SW of Lesser Tunb; hail terminated when Omani frigate approached.

events.title: Iranian shadow fleet AIS spoofing detected
events.summary: Open-source AIS analyst groups report 14 Iranian-linked tankers transmitting spoofed MMSI signatures suggesting transit through southwestern Persian Gulf; actual positions unverified.

events.title: ADNOC reroutes via ADCOP pipeline
events.summary: ADNOC announces 1.5 MBD will move via Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline to Fujairah, fully bypassing the strait; spot deliveries shift to Fujairah anchorage.

events.title: Qatar offers mediation channel
events.summary: Qatar's Emir reportedly extends backchannel offer through Doha Forum to Tehran; tied to LNG security guarantees for Asian buyers.

events.title: Bahrain HQ Fifth Fleet raises FPCON Charlie
events.summary: U.S. Naval Forces Central Command raises Force Protection Condition to Charlie at NSA Bahrain; non-essential personnel offload begins.

events.title: Oman activates Muscat backchannel
events.summary: Omani FM travels to Tehran for direct talks; historically the only Gulf state with reliable IRGC channels; outcome closed-door.

events.title: Iranian S-300 system tracked at Bandar Abbas
events.summary: Commercial radar feeds (RFCalc consortium) detect S-300PMU-2 site illuminating coastal sectors; defensive posture, not offensive intent.
